integrity: The proof is symbolic and quantified over every rank-two, rank-three, and rank-four transformation on five points. A standalone verifier exhausts all 3000 such transformations and every ordered pair of distinct two-subsets, and separately verifies the two A5 orbit statements used in the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result proves the strictness of the inclusion from 4-transitive to strongly sync-maximal permutation groups using the natural degree-five action of A5. It does not classify all strongly sync-maximal groups.
title: \(A_5\) is strongly sync-maximal without being \(4\)-transitive
